capability_policy: Reference ceiling is C4. C4 requires explicit human approval; C5 is non-default and additionally requires an expiry or maximum-action bound. Engine/Supreme authority and Guardian/Constitution bypass are permanently non-grantable.

heterogeneous Guardian Jury with explicit UNCERTAIN state
known_limits: reference deterministic cognition is not a frontier neural model
symbolic inference covers a deliberately small relation set
the Model cannot grant itself Aurora Engine authority
external execution remains dependent on an authenticated compatible Aurora Engine
a natural-language constitution cannot be mathematically guaranteed against every possible future interpretation
Guardian Jury hardening reduces single-path semantic failure but does not mathematically guarantee correct interpretation of arbitrary open-ended situations
